name: Turns head off-screen
text: She turns her head to look off-screen left.
desc: Directs the audience at something outside the frame; sets up the next cut. On a close shot it stays a head turn; staged wide it keeps going and carries the whole body round into a walk-off.

measured.staging_note: subject_scale is the fraction of the frame the subject's coat occupies in that staging's keyframe - the run's measure of how close the subject is staged.

verdict: RE-MEASURED ACROSS FOUR STAGINGS 2026-08-04, 3 seeds each, watched at 7702. The head turns off-screen left at all four stagings; 0.570 / 0.709 / 0.857 / 0.592, all inside their own bands. AT THE TWO WIDE STAGINGS IT DOES NOT STOP AT THE HEAD - by f84 at `far` and f72 at `mid` the turn has carried the whole body round and she walks off. At `close` and `anchor` it stays a head turn and the shot still ends on her. A card whose SCOPE, not just its size, is set by the staging.
staging_robustness_evidence: four stagings (subject 0.19%-7.92% of frame), three seeds of numbers, strips watched at seed 7702: samples/motion_staging/percard/head_turn.png
